title: Canyon China current warranty and guarantee terms
notes: Current China policy describes a 2-year warranty for Canyon-designed frame/fork/handlebar/seatpost and at least 2 years for original-component makers (unless stated otherwise), for delivery-time material/workmanship defects. The 6-year guarantee covers Canyon-designed parts only for the original owner and is non-transferable; third-party components are excluded. Proof may be requested for transferred ownership within the 2-year warranty, and eligible claims include covered reassembly, shipping and customs. Collision, wear, corrosion and use beyond intended category are excluded. General brand terms do not establish a specific bike's purchase date or claim eligibility.
